room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen; not applied where differential billing not followed

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges all-inclusive as provided by hospital

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every admissible claim; waiver available as optional paid add-on

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; stents/implants at DPCO/NPPA prices

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: 36 months for general PEDs; 24 months for pre-existing disability; 90 days for HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, calculi, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl 18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days from discharge

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary treatment benefit mentioned in the policy wording

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of sum insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense cover mentioned in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of sum insured; includes robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, etc.

consumables.note: Consumables listed in List I are excluded; no optional consumables rider mentioned

global_cover.note: Territorial limit restricts all treatment to India

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, claims cannot be contested except for fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability

portability.note: Credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, NCB and moratorium transferable to new insurer

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, dental (unless accident), venereal disease (except HIV), erectile dysfunction, EECP/chelation/hyperbaric O2, spectacles/hearing aids, circumcision

optional_riders.display: Waiver of 20% co-payment (optional add-on on payment of additional premium)
